summary.text: Laurel LaPorte-Grimes is the Democratic candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Henri Martin (R).

On her campaign website, she describes a career as a program developer, evaluator, community organizer and advocate, and says she is running to represent Bristol, Plainville, Plymouth, Thomaston and Harwinton.
